There's no `release:` target in any Makefile in this checkout on `main`. It may be on another branch or not merged yet. I noted that in the memory, along with the fact that I haven't confirmed whether the `vYYYY.MM.N` tag format is still used. If you tell me the tag format, I'll add it.
